title: UCIP city configuration
description: Everything the pipeline and the frontend need to know about one city. Validated in CI so a malformed config fails in seconds rather than forty minutes into an Earth Engine run.

slug.description: Filename-safe id, used as --city and as the config filename.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Used by the live-temperature widget.

bbox.description: [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] in WGS84. Doubles as the plausibility bound the grid stage checks its output against.

file.description: GeoJSON filename under data/, holding one polygon per ward.

ward_id_field.description: Property on each feature carrying the ward code.

projected_crs.description: Metric CRS for area and distance. Omit to derive the UTM zone from the bbox centroid; getting this wrong silently distorts every area in the pipeline.

ecology.description: Local ecological assumptions behind the plantability filter. These do NOT transfer between cities.

calibrated.description: Whether the plantability thresholds have actually been reviewed for this city's ecology, or are inherited from Mumbai and still need checking.
